# `<sl-progress-bar>` — Progress Bar

Progress bars are used to show the status of an ongoing operation.

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 2.0

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/progress-bar/progress-bar.js';`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | — | `number` | `0` | The current progress as a percentage, 0 to 100. |
| `indeterminate` | — | `boolean` | `false` | When true, percentage is ignored, the label is hidden, and the progress bar is drawn in an indeterminate state. |
| `label` | — | `string` | `''` | A custom label for assistive devices. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | A label to show inside the progress indicator. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `indicator` | The progress bar's indicator. |
| `label` | The progress bar's label. |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--height` | — | The progress bar's height. |
| `--track-color` | — | The color of the track. |
| `--indicator-color` | — | The color of the indicator. |
| `--label-color` | — | The color of the label. |

```html
<sl-progress-bar value="50"></sl-progress-bar>
```

## Examples

### Labels

Use the `label` attribute to label the progress bar and tell assistive devices how to announce it.

```html
<sl-progress-bar value="50" label="Upload progress"></sl-progress-bar>
```

### Custom Height

Use the `--height` custom property to set the progress bar's height.

```html
<sl-progress-bar value="50" style="--height: 6px;"></sl-progress-bar>
```

### Showing Values

Use the default slot to show a value.

```html
<sl-progress-bar value="50" class="progress-bar-values">50%</sl-progress-bar>

<br />

<sl-button circle><sl-icon name="dash" label="Decrease"></sl-icon></sl-button>
<sl-button circle><sl-icon name="plus" label="Increase"></sl-icon></sl-button>

<script>
  const progressBar = document.querySelector('.progress-bar-values');
  const subtractButton = progressBar.nextElementSibling.nextElementSibling;
  const addButton = subtractButton.nextElementSibling;

  addButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const value = Math.min(100, progressBar.value + 10);
    progressBar.value = value;
    progressBar.textContent = `${value}%`;
  });

  subtractButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const value = Math.max(0, progressBar.value - 10);
    progressBar.value = value;
    progressBar.textContent = `${value}%`;
  });
</script>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/button/button.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/icon/icon.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/progress-bar/progress-bar.js';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA, signal } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-progress-bar-values-example',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-progress-bar [value]="value()">{{ value() }}%</sl-progress-bar>

    <br />

    <sl-button circle (click)="step(-10)"><sl-icon name="dash" label="Decrease"></sl-icon></sl-button>
    <sl-button circle (click)="step(10)"><sl-icon name="plus" label="Increase"></sl-icon></sl-button>
  `
})
export class ProgressBarValuesExampleComponent {
  readonly value = signal(50);

  step(delta: number) {
    this.value.update(current => Math.min(100, Math.max(0, current + delta)));
  }
}
```

### Indeterminate

The `indeterminate` attribute can be used to inform the user that the operation is pending, but its status cannot currently be determined. In this state, `value` is ignored and the label, if present, will not be shown.

```html
<sl-progress-bar indeterminate></sl-progress-bar>
```
